cli_claims.note: recorded for comparison only; never used to decide the case outcome

hpm_counters.scope: software-bracketed entire measured batch, not common hardware window

cases.hpm_note: HPM phase counters bracket each software phase (including MMIO) and are not exact hardware windows; they are reported beside, never instead of, the common window

lane_active.meaning: close-latched lane state: lane_active_q is only updated while the cost session is active and is frozen at the closing edge; a natural carry-out legitimately latches the A lane and is not an error
lane_active.note: information only: reported, never used to pass or fail a case, and it never suppresses the closed-window, completion-accounting or quarantine/data-error checks

rates.note: both rates use raw 0xc19 (common window) and the P4M common-window A done field; raw 0xc04 is whole-arm occupancy and is never a denominator

cost.separation_note: whole arm: raw 0xc03..0xc07 (whole session, (arm, close]); common window: raw 0xc19..0xc23 (the (open, close] hardware window). The two are never added.
notes: samples are every 16th fully contained completed A copy; a copy that completes on the closing edge is still contained and is marked separately
zero samples and small samples are legitimate and are never treated as errors
whole-arm and common-window occupancy are reported separately and never mixed

fullstats_comparison.sampled_population: the legacy fixed-phase sampler: every 16th fully contained completed A copy
fullstats_comparison.fullstats_population: every eligible A copy committed in the common hardware window (full aggregation)
fullstats_comparison.comparison_rule: only same (req, miss) groups are compared, and only means and min/max ranges; the sampler sees one fixed phase of the copy cadence while the full block sees the whole eligible population, so neither yields a population median

cost.lane_active_field: raw[0xc2c] (close-latched lane state, never capture-time busy)
cost.lane_active_note: raw[0xc2c] lane_active is only updated while the cost session is active and is frozen at the closing edge; it is a close-latched lane state, reported as information only, and a natural carry-out legitimately latches the A lane
cost.sampling_phase_note: samples are taken every 16th eligible A copy, so the sampler observes one fixed phase of the copy cadence; per-sample and grouped statistics describe only that sampled phase and are never extrapolated to the whole A population
cost.repetition_note: three runs per condition are engineering repetition: no p-value, no novelty claim and no full-method decision
cost.zero_sample_note: zero or small sample counts are legitimate and are not errors
fullstats_notes: 全量统计覆盖共同窗口内全部合格 A 搬运；旧每 16 次抽样只覆盖一个固定相位，二者只按相同 req/miss 组比较均值与范围。
抽样与全量都只给出均值与范围；没有原始全量记录就不宣称总体中位数，也不推断分位数。
组 0..4 的键为 requests=4 且 IOTLB miss=g（g=0..4）；组 5 是其他组合，只列实际计数、总和与范围，不给它虚构固定的 req/miss 键。
req 记录 select 事件，miss 记录 IOTLB 查找未命中，两者分别计数，不是完整 DDT/PDT/PTW 类型加权基线；本段统计不是缓解方法 M 的收益。

hpm.note: HPM phase counters bracket each software phase (including MMIO) and are not exact hardware windows; they are reported separately and never mixed with the common window

input_hashes.note: hashed before and after the read/analysis phase; the report is written outside the input directory

notes: per-case classifications, per-condition counts and run-local marks only
no case, condition or repetition is upgraded to a global or hardware claim
one case never establishes an E2 positive result for the whole matrix
three repetitions per condition are engineering repetition: no p-value, no novelty claim, no full-method decision
explicit unknowns are reported where the evidence cannot establish a causal chain
failed, missing and surprising no-aggressor cases are kept and flagged, never dropped and never retried

cost-fullstats is a fixed, independent 21-case collection segment (the three short cost cases plus Solo/A1g0/A8g0/A16g0/A8g1000/A8g2000 in blocks b01..b03); each case is a separate execution (not assumed statistically independent), and group copies are not board-level repetition

every cost-fullstats case requires the fullstats block: a missing block or a sticky error is a failure, and the req/select and IOTLB-miss counters are counts of select events and IOTLB lookup misses, not a complete DDT/PDT/PTW type-weighted baseline and not a method-M benefit
sampled and fullstats statistics are compared only as means and ranges of the same (req, miss) group: no population median is inferred from the aggregated sums and counts
